lore.title: The Retired Witch
lore.summary: Before anything else, Caitlyn was a witch. They retired from witchcraft, though the magic never fully left.

lore.title: Audio Engineer Pivot
lore.summary: After retiring, the witch switched careers to audio engineering. That's why the mic always sounds suspiciously good.

lore.title: Becoming an Anime Gepeng
lore.summary: Then came another pivot: becoming a flat anime girl (a VTuber), mostly out of boredom (gabut).

lore.title: @bukancaitlyn
lore.summary: The YouTube handle literally means "not Caitlyn". Caitlyn also posts on X as @Y2Karyl.

lore.title: Back From Retirement
lore.summary: The Witcheel stream: "I'm back from retirement, now what?" The witch returns, sort of.

lore.title: Penyihir Jalur Keyboard Warrior
lore.summary: During TypeCaster, Caitlyn became a witch who casts spells by typing. A keyboard-warrior witch.

lore.title: The Mac mini 2009
lore.summary: A 2009 Mac mini that Caitlyn put macOS Tahoe on in TECH TALK streams. Is it usable? There was also talk of overclocking it.

lore.title: Guerilla Freetalk
lore.summary: Surprise free-talk streams that show up with little warning. Check the menu bar.
